tasks.title: Service Selection Screen
tasks.description: First step in the booking flow where customers choose their grooming service
acceptanceCriteria: Customer can view all available grooming services with visual cards
Each service displays its name, description, duration, and pricing for all dog sizes
Customer can select one service by clicking its card
Selected service is visually highlighted with a checkmark
Continue button advances to the next step
Progress indicator shows step 1 of 4

tasks.title: Dog Size Selection Screen
tasks.description: Second step where customers specify their dog's size category
acceptanceCriteria: Customer sees their previously selected service in a summary box
Customer can choose from 4 size options: Small, Medium, Large, and X-Large
Each size displays weight range, example breeds, and a size-appropriate illustration
Selected size is visually highlighted
Back button returns to service selection without losing data
Continue button advances to time selection
Progress indicator shows step 2 of 4
Helpful message explains that size can be confirmed on arrival

tasks.title: Time Selection Screen
tasks.description: Third step with calendar and time slot picker
acceptanceCriteria: Customer sees summary of selected service and dog size
Customer can view a monthly calendar with navigation arrows
Past dates are shown as disabled and cannot be selected
Available time slots are displayed for the selected date
Unavailable/booked time slots are shown with strikethrough and cannot be selected
Selected date and time are visually highlighted
Back button returns to size selection
Continue button advances to payment
Progress indicator shows step 3 of 4

tasks.title: Payment & Deposit Screen
tasks.description: Fourth step where customers pay the $20 deposit to secure their booking
acceptanceCriteria: Complete booking summary is displayed (service, dog size, date, time, duration)
Deposit amount of exactly $20 is prominently shown
Clear message explains the deposit secures the appointment and remaining balance is due after service
Customer can enter card details: card number, name on card, expiration date, and CVV
Accepted card types are displayed (Visa, MC, Amex, Discover)
Security messaging assures customer their payment is encrypted
Cancellation policy is shown with link
Back button allows returning to previous steps
Pay button submits the payment
Progress indicator shows step 4 of 4

tasks.title: Confirmation Screen
tasks.description: Final success screen showing booking details and reference number
acceptanceCriteria: Success message with animated checkmark is displayed
Customer receives a unique booking reference number (format: PG-####)
Complete appointment details are shown: date, time, service, dog size, location with address
Deposit paid amount ($20) is confirmed
What to Expect section shows 3 clear steps for the appointment day
Customer can add appointment to their calendar
Customer can view all their bookings
Contact information (phone and email) is provided for changes
Confirmation email message is mentioned

tasks.title: Admin Schedule Dashboard
tasks.description: Administrative view showing all appointments and daily statistics
acceptanceCriteria: Current date is prominently displayed
Dashboard shows 4 key statistics: Total Appointments, Completed, Upcoming, and Revenue Today
Each appointment card displays: time, duration, customer name, pet name, dog size, service type, phone number, and booking reference
Appointment status is shown with color-coded badges (Confirmed, Pending)
Admin can filter view by: All, Today, Tomorrow, or Week
Admin can refresh the schedule
Admin can create a new booking
Appointments are sorted by time

tasks.title: Booking Flow Navigation
tasks.description: Multi-step flow controller that manages progression and state preservation
acceptanceCriteria: Customer cannot skip steps in the booking process
Back buttons preserve all previously entered information
Progress bar accurately reflects current step (1-4 of 4)
Completed steps are visually indicated in the progress bar
Customer selections remain visible in summary boxes on subsequent screens
Navigation is smooth without page refreshes where possible

tasks.title: Appointment Booking System
tasks.description: Backend system that creates, stores, and retrieves booking records
acceptanceCriteria: Successfully completed bookings appear in the admin dashboard immediately
Each booking generates a unique reference number
Booking stores all customer information: name, phone, service, dog size, date, time
Time slots that are booked become unavailable for other customers
Booking status can be Confirmed or Pending
Bookings persist across sessions
Revenue calculations are automatically updated
Admin can view booking details by reference number

tasks.title: Service Selection Screen
tasks.description: Customer-facing screen where users browse and select from available grooming services
acceptanceCriteria: Customer sees 5 service options: Bath & Brush, Full Groom, Haircut Only, Nail Trim & File, and Teeth Brushing
Each service card displays a photo, description, duration, and pricing by dog size
Customer can click a service card to select it, and the card shows a checkmark
Selected service card has a visual highlight (colored border)
Continue button is visible and takes customer to the next step
Progress indicator shows step 1 of 4

tasks.title: Dog Size Selection Screen
tasks.description: Customer selects their dog's size category to determine final pricing
acceptanceCriteria: Customer sees 4 size options: Small, Medium, Large, and X-Large with weight ranges
Each size card shows an illustration and example breeds
Customer can click a size card to select it, and the card shows a checkmark
Selected size card has a warm yellow background color
Customer sees their previously selected service at the top of the screen
Info message explains that weight will be confirmed at arrival
Back button is visible and returns to service selection
Progress indicator shows step 2 of 4

tasks.title: Time Slot Selection Screen
tasks.description: Customer picks their preferred appointment date and time
acceptanceCriteria: Customer sees a calendar view for the current month (August 2026)
Past dates are visually disabled and cannot be selected
Customer can click an available date to select it
After selecting a date, customer sees available time slots for that day
Unavailable time slots are grayed out with strikethrough and cannot be selected
Customer can click an available time slot to select it
Selected time slot has an orange background
Customer sees their service and dog size summary at the top
Back button returns to size selection
Progress indicator shows step 3 of 4

tasks.title: Payment & Deposit Screen
tasks.description: Customer reviews their booking and pays the $20 deposit
acceptanceCriteria: Customer sees complete booking summary: service, dog size, date/time, and duration
Deposit amount of $20 is prominently displayed in a highlighted card
Deposit card explains that $20 will be deducted from final service price
Customer sees payment form with fields for card number, name, expiration, and CVV
Card type icons (VISA, MC, AMEX, DISC) are visible below card number field
Security message confirms payment information is encrypted
Pay button clearly shows '$20 Deposit' as the amount
Cancellation policy is visible with 24-hour refund terms
Back button returns to time selection
Progress indicator shows step 4 of 4

tasks.title: Booking Confirmation Screen
tasks.description: Customer receives confirmation after successful payment
acceptanceCriteria: Customer sees a success checkmark animation and 'You're All Set!' message
Booking reference number is displayed prominently (format: PG-####)
Complete appointment details are shown: date, time, service, dog size, and location
Deposit paid amount ($20.00) is confirmed
Phone number for the grooming shop is displayed as a clickable link
Email confirmation message is mentioned
Customer sees 3 steps explaining what to expect (arrive early, bring leash, text notification)
'Add to Calendar' button is visible
'View My Bookings' button is visible
Email contact link is provided

tasks.title: Admin Schedule Dashboard
tasks.description: Staff view to see and manage daily appointments
acceptanceCriteria: Admin sees current date displayed at top of screen
4 stat cards show: Total Appointments, Completed, Upcoming, and Revenue Today
Stats update to reflect current day's data
Admin sees filter tabs: All, Today, Tomorrow, Week
Appointment list shows all bookings with time, duration, customer name, pet name/size, service, and phone
Each appointment displays booking reference number
Status badges show 'Confirmed' or 'Pending' for each appointment
Appointments are sorted by time
Refresh button reloads the latest data
New Booking button is visible to create walk-in appointments

tasks.title: Booking Data Persistence
tasks.description: Store and retrieve customer booking information
acceptanceCriteria: Customer's selected service persists when moving to next screen
Customer's selected dog size persists when moving to next screen
Customer's selected date and time persists when moving to next screen
Customer can use back button without losing their selections
Booking reference number is unique for each completed booking
Customer booking appears in admin dashboard after completion

tasks.title: Availability Management
tasks.description: Track and display available appointment time slots
acceptanceCriteria: Time slots already booked by other customers show as unavailable
Same time slot cannot be selected by two different customers
Calendar only shows future dates as available
After a booking is confirmed, that time slot becomes unavailable to other customers
Admin dashboard shows which time slots are filled

tasks.title: Payment Processing Integration
acceptanceCriteria: Customer is charged exactly $20 for the deposit
Payment processes when customer clicks 'Pay $20 Deposit' button
Customer sees confirmation screen only after successful payment
Failed payment shows an error message without creating a booking
Receipt confirmation is mentioned in the confirmation screen

tasks.title: Design System Foundation
tasks.description: Shared visual design, colors, and component styles
acceptanceCriteria: All screens use the warm yellow background (#fefce8)
All screens use consistent orange primary color (#d97706) for buttons and highlights
Progress indicator appears consistently across all 4 customer screens
Cards and buttons have consistent rounded corners (12px radius)
All screens are mobile-responsive with max-width of 480px for customer flow
Typography and spacing is consistent across all screens
